metadata.description: Give Claude a reference video. /shotlist extracts scene-change frames and a transcript, then emits a per-shot generation brief (still-image prompt + motion note per cut) alongside the full editorial analysis.

plugins.name: shotlist
plugins.description: Shot-list a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts scene-change frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or Whisper, emits a structured report.md with one image prompt + one motion note per shot, optional Obsidian auto-save.
